channel.title: ClearHire Docs
channel.description: Build resumes, prove your employment history, and track applications.

item.title: Moving to ClearHire from another CV tool or job board
item.description: One page per product: how to move from it to ClearHire, or an honest note where nothing moves. Every fact is dated and links to the page it came from.

item.title: Blind and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Blind is anonymous talk among verified professionals; ClearHire puts a named company’s answer on your own record. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Canva to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Canva for ClearHire with a resume: get the words out of the design’s text boxes, enter them once as a record, keep Canva for everything else you make. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Certn and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Certn screens candidates for employers, contacting past employers for titles and dates; ClearHire keeps that answer on the person’s own record. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Checkr and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Checkr runs background checks for employers after the offer; ClearHire keeps confirmed roles for the person before it. Nothing moves across. Where to start. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Comparably and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Comparably collects anonymous culture ratings; ClearHire reviews sit beside a countersigned role, and both sides can write. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Dice to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Dice: tech teams can post here without a monthly slot and see roles a former employer countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Enhancv to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Enhancv for ClearHire: the free plan lasts seven days and downloads PDF only, so copy the text first, then paste it in and get each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from FlexJobs to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving FlexJobs for ClearHire as a job seeker: a free board where the employer mark means a company answers claims, not that a listing passed a screen. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from FlowCV to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving FlowCV for ClearHire: your free PDF comes out clean; ours carries one line on Free. How to bring the resume, letter and tracked jobs across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Glassdoor for Employers to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Glassdoor for Employers: keep answering reviews where candidates read them; post here with a published price and a mark that means you answer claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Glassdoor reviews and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Glassdoor reviews and interview accounts, answered by employers; ClearHire reviews are tied to a countersigned role. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Himalayas to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Himalayas: remote employers post here too, and remote candidates can filter to companies that confirm employment. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Indeed to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Indeed: employers post the role again here, job seekers bring their applications into one tracker and filter for companies that answer claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Indeed Company Reviews and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Indeed Company Reviews are anonymous accounts of workplaces; ClearHire reviews sit beside a countersigned role. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Jobicy to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Jobicy: a one-time 30-day remote listing there, a post here, and a candidate filter for companies that answer claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Kickresume to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Kickresume for ClearHire: bring the resume text and cover letters, rebuild the website’s links as a portfolio, and get each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from LinkedIn Jobs to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside LinkedIn Jobs: post the role here at a published price, keep LinkedIn for the network, and track applications from both in one list. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from LinkedIn workplace verification to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: A LinkedIn workplace badge does not transfer. Ask the company again on ClearHire, starting with roles you have left, and print the answer on your resume. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from LiveCareer to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving LiveCareer for ClearHire: the free version downloads TXT, the trial adds PDF, Word and RTF. Bring the text across and get roles countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Monster to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Monster: post here without a daily budget, search talent by skill, and let candidates filter to companies that answer claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from MyPerfectResume to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving MyPerfectResume for ClearHire: free downloads are TXT, PDF and Word sit on a renewing plan. Bring your trade’s wording across and get roles countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Novoresume to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Novoresume for ClearHire: your one-page Basic resume comes out as a branded PDF; copy it in, split it into versions, get each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Reactive Resume to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Reactive Resume for ClearHire: its JSON export will not load here, so copy from the Word file. Keep your self-hosted copy if you run one. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Remote OK to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Remote OK: its Verified tag means an email domain matched; ours means a named person answers employment claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Resume Genius to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Resume Genius for ClearHire: the free resume download is TXT, the free cover letter comes as Word. Bring both across and get each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from resume.io to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving resume.io for ClearHire: save the TXT or trial PDF, mind the four-week renewal, paste your roles in once and get them countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Rezi to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Rezi for ClearHire: spend one of the three free PDF downloads, keep the AI-written bullets you liked, then get each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from SEEK to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside SEEK: hire in Australia or New Zealand on SEEK, and post here too at a published price with a verified filter for candidates. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from SEEK Pass, Career History to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: A SEEK Pass Career History tick does not transfer. Ask the company again on ClearHire, including for roles you have left, and the answer travels with your file. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Teal to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Teal for ClearHire: the tracker is the part to move with care. Bring active applications, pick one master resume, then get roles countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Truework and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Truework sells employment and income checks to lenders; ClearHire keeps a record for the person. Nothing moves across. Where to start instead. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Veremark and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Veremark sells employment checks to hiring teams per candidate; ClearHire keeps confirmed roles with the person. Nothing moves across. Where to start. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from VisualCV to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving VisualCV for ClearHire: take the Word file from the builder, keep your live link up while it is still out there, then have each role countersigned. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from We Work Remotely to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside We Work Remotely: post a role here without the per-post fee, and let candidates filter to companies that answer claims. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Wellfound to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside Wellfound: a startup can post here as well as there, and candidates can filter to companies that confirm employment. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Workamper News to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Moving your Workamper News history to ClearHire: ask each seasonal employer to countersign the role, any trade, any year. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Xref and ClearHire: how they differ, where to start
item.description: Xref automates reference checks for employers; a ClearHire record is the person’s, confirmed once and readable by every later employer. Nothing moves across. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from Zety to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Leaving Zety for ClearHire: take the Word file if you are on the paid tier, keep the wording you liked, and stop a four-weekly renewal on your own terms. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: Moving from ZipRecruiter to ClearHire: steps and dated facts
item.description: Using ClearHire beside ZipRecruiter: we could not read its pages on 7 November 2026, so this guide covers only what changes on our side. Facts checked 7 November 2026.

item.description: ClearHire has challenges, badges, levels and an opt-in leaderboard. Points come from finishing a challenge, never from opening the app, and there is no streak to break.
